newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch to push for European doctors' database.
newsitem.headline: Dutch to push for European doctors' database.

text.p: Establishment of a Europe-wide database to track doctors' qualifications and conduct will be high on the agenda at a European Union health ministers meeting in June, the Dutch health ministry said on Tuesday.
A major function of the database would be to ensure that physicians struck off for misconduct in one country are not able resume practising in another, the ministry said.

At a symposium in Amsterdam on Monday, EU health officials and doctor and patient organisations also discussed relative standards of medical training across the Union and ways of raising the quality of patient care, it said.

The conference concluded that current EU safeguards on professional misconduct do not go far enough, the ministry said, and the proposed database will receive top priority at the ministerial council hosted by the Dutch EU presidency.
